name: 프레이야-륌 (Freya-Lrym)
hair: 눈부시게 밝은 스카이 블루 색상의 짧은 픽셀 헤어
outfit: 북유럽 룬 문자가 새겨진 짙은 파란색 털 코트와 흰색 룬 자수 튜닉
gloves: 털 장식이 달린 두꺼운 흰색 가죽 장갑
shoes: 룬 문자가 빛나는 짙은 남색 부츠
accessories: 몸 주변을 떠다니는 빛나는 푸른색 마법 불꽃 파편들
weapon: 룬 문자가 새겨진 푸른색 마법 지팡이
silhouette: 둥글고 통통한 체형, 머리 위로 떠다니는 마법 입자들, 길고 굵은 지팡이, 털 장식이 부풀어 오른 코트 실루엣
signature_motion: 지팡이를 휘둘러 주변에 푸른 불꽃을 방출하는 동작
signature_vfx: 스카이 블루 색상의 강렬한 화염이 소용돌이치는 모습
visual_en: A round-bodied character with pale, porcelain skin. The head features bright sky-blue short hair and glowing sky-blue eyes. Wearing a thick, deep blue fur-trimmed coat adorned with white rune patterns and a white tunic. Large, thick white fur gloves cover the hands. The lower body consists of dark navy boots with glowing blue runes. Around the body, numerous bright sky-blue magical flame fragments float dynamically. A long, sturdy magic staff with glowing runes is held, and a small icy spirit floats nearby, all rendered in high-saturation blue tones.
pose_en: Standing firmly with the staff pointed downwards, surrounded by swirling blue embers.
vfx_en: Swirling surges of intense sky-blue flames and sparkling frost particles.
motion_en: Orbital summoning of blue flame fragments

frame_notes.entrance_2: Only the character itself with a few blue flames and sparkles close around it. No box, panel, frame, wall, doorway, pillar or background shape of any kind; the background stays empty

body_plan.body: A small, humanoid character with blue hair, wearing a blue and white outfit with a fur collar, standing upright.
